record.description: Four sub-scores on a 0–1 scale; the score is the unweighted mean of the sub-scores that have data, times 100. Missing inputs are left out (never counted as zero); confidence = sub-scores present / 4. Standing: conferences ICORE A*=1, A=0.8, B=0.6, C=0.4, National/Regional=0.3; journals SJR Q1=1, Q2=0.75, Q3=0.5, Q4=0.25. Impact: log scale, min(1, log10(1+x)/log10(1+cap)); journals x = OpenAlex 2-yr mean citedness, cap 10; conferences x = Semantic Scholar citations per paper of the cohort year, cap 40. Stability: r = largest yearly paper count / median active year over the last 10 full years (needs 3+ active years); 1 - (r-2)/8, clamped to 0–1. Integrity: journals: retractions per 1,000 papers (Retraction Watch / OpenAlex works), 1 - rate/50; conferences: 1 - retractions/50 when retractions > 0, otherwise no signal. All sub-scores rounded to 3 decimals and the score to 1 decimal, so recomputation matches exactly.

Conferences (GGS rating): every source gives a class; the three classes are combined with the published GGS table. ICORE: A*→A++, A→A, B→B, C→C, anything else no class. OpenAlex and SCImago: position p = 1 + number of sample venues with a strictly larger h-index (ties share the best position), estimated rank r = ceil(p / N × 800) with N the sample size; class by rank: r≤50 A++, ≤75 A+, ≤200 A, ≤250 A-, ≤575 B, ≤650 B-, else C. OpenAlex is then corrected by lifetime average citations a = cited_by_count / works_count (≥25 A++, ≥23 A+, ≥18 A, ≥16 A-, ≥12 B, ≥10 B-, ≥7 C, else D) with the GGS correction rules; SCImago is not corrected. Three classes: table lookup. Two classes: a virtual third equal to the lower one is added, then the result is capped at A (flag "two sources only (capped at A)"). One or none: "Work in progress" (flag "not classifiable"). Points = sum of the class scores of the three classes used (A++=7, A+=6, A=5, A-=4, B=3, B-=2, C=1), including a virtual third; confidence = sources with a class / 3. Journals (Polish method): percentile of each indicator within the sample = 100 × (venues strictly lower + 0.5 × other venues equal) / N, rounded to 1 decimal; band ≥97→200, ≥90→140, ≥75→100, ≥50→70, ≥25→40, else 20. Class = the higher band; points = the higher percentile; confidence = indicators present / 2. No indicator: "Not rated". Flags never change class or points: "not ranked (ICORE)", "not indexed (SCImago)", "sources disagree" (bands 2+ steps apart), "publication spike" (OpenAlex works per year over the last 10 full years) and "retraction wave", with the same rules and thresholds as 0.1-demo.
